exposure: planned home vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
women with a history of prior cesarean delivery
cohort: Women in the United States from 2007-2014 who had one or more prior cesarean deliveries and delivered a term, normal weight infant
finding: Women with a planned home VBAC had an approximately 10-fold higher increase in adverse neonatal outcomes, including 5-minute Apgar score of 0 and neonatal seizures or severe neurologic dysfunction, compared to hospital VBACs and hospital repeat cesarean deliveries.
